content: Aramas Kahngohdiong Kupwur en KAUN-O
Ni rahn kaeisek en kelimaun sounpwong en keisuhwen sounpar en at kalipilipala. Ekei kaunen mehn Israel ko ahpw patohdo rehi pwe re en ale kaweid duwen kupwur en KAUN-O, re ahpw mwohndi mwohi.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong ie,

“Kowe, nein aramas, lokaiaiong aramas pwukat oh ndaiong irail dahme KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanih: Kumwail seu kodohn rapahki kupwurei? I kahukihla nin duwen ngehi, Koht ieias, I sohte pahn mweidohng kumwail en kalelapak rehi mehkot. Ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen.
“Kowe, nein aramas, ke onopadahr ke en kadeikirailda? Eri, wenla mwowe. Katamankin irail duwen tiahk saut kan me ar pahpa ko wiadahr.
Ndaiong irail dahme I mahmahsanih. Ni ei pilada Israel, I wiahiong irail inou ehu. I kasalehiong irail pein ngehi nan Isip oh mahsanihong irail: Ngehi me KAUN-O, amwail Koht.
Iei ih ahnsowo me I inoukihong irail me I pahn wairailsang nan Isip oh kahluwairaillahng nan sahpw me I piladahr ong irail, sahpw kaselel oh pwelmwahu, sahpw me keieu kaselel nanpwungen sahpw akan.
I mahsanihong irail re en kesehla dikedik en eni kan me re kin poakohng oh re en dehr kasaminehkinirailla koht likamw akan en Isip, pwehki ngehi me KAUN-O, ar Koht.
Ahpw re kahngohdiong ie oh sohte men rong ei mahsen. Re sohte kesehla nair dikedik en eni saut kan de kesehla koht en Isip ko. I onopadahr I en mweidohng pwe re en kehn engin ei engieng nan Isip.
Ahpw I sohte kapwaiada pwe I dehr kasohwauwihala mwarei, pwehki ei pakairkidahr mwohn aramas akan me mehn Israel kan kin koukousoan rehrail me I pahn kahluwa irail sang nan Isip.
“Eri, I kahluwa irail sang nan Isip kolahng nan sapwtehno.
I ketikihong irail ei koasoandi oh padahkihong irail ei kosonned kan, me kin kihong mour ong mehmen me pahn peikiong.
I kilelehdi koasoandi kan en rahnen Sapad pwehn wia kilel en inou nanpwungen ngehi oh irail, pwe en katamankin irail me ngehi, KAUN-O, me kasarawihirailla.

Ahpw re pil kahngohdiong ie nan sapwtehno. Re kauwehla ei kosonned kan oh soikala ei koasoandi kan, me kin kihong mour ong mehmen me pahn peikiong. Re kasaminehla douluhl rahnen Sapad. I onopadahr I en mweidohng pwe re en kehn engin ei engieng nan sapwtehno oh I en kamwomwirailla.
Ahpw I sohte kapwaiada, pwehki met pahn kasohwauwihala mwarei rehn wehi kan me kilangehr duwen ei kahluwa Israel sang nan Isip.
Ngehi eri wiahda inou ehu nan sapwtehno me I sohte pahn kahluwairaillahng nan sahpwo me I ketikihongirailehr, sahpw kaselel oh pwelmwahuo, sahpw me keieu kaselel nanpwungen sahpw akan.
I wiahda inowo pwehki ar soikala ei koasoandi kan, kauwehla ei kosonned kan, oh kasaminehla rahnen Sapad—re pilada re en pwongih dikedik en eni kan.
“Ahpw I poakeirailla. I koasoanehdi I en dehr kemeirailla nan sapwtehno.
I kehkehlingkihong me pwulopwul ko: Kumwail dehr kapwaiada kosonned kan me amwail pahpa kahlap ako wiadahr; kumwail dehr idawehn arail tiahk de kasaminehkinkumwailla neirail dikedik en eni kan.
Ngehi me KAUN-O, amwail Koht. Kumwail kapwaiada ei kosonned oh koasoandi kan.
Wiahkihla rahnen Sapad rahn sarawi ehu, pwe en wia kilel en inou me kitail wiadahr, oh pahn katamankin kumwail me ngehi, KAUN-O, amwail Koht.

“Ahpw diho pil kahngohdiong ie. Re kauwehla ei kosonned oh sohte kapwaiada ei koasoandi kan, me kin kihong mour ong mehmen me pahn peikiong. Re kasaminehla rahnen Sapad. I onopadahr I en mweidohng pwe re en kehn engin ei engieng nan sapwtehno oh kemeirailla koaros.
Ahpw I sohte kapwaiada, pwehki met pahn kasohwauwihala mwarei rehn wehi kan me kilang duwen ei kahluwa mehn Israel kan sang nan Isip.
Ngehi eri pil wiahda ehu inou nan sapwtehno. I inoukihda me I pahn kamwarakirailpeseng wasa koaros nan sampah.
I wiadahr met pwehki ar soikala ei koasoandi kan, kauwehla ei kosonned kan, kasaminehla rahnen Sapad, oh pwongih soangen dikedik en enikohte me ar pahpa kahlap ako kin papah.
“Ngehi eri ketikihong irail kosonned kan me sohte mwahu oh koasoandi me sohte pahn kihong aramas mour.
I mweidohng re en kasaminehkinirailla pein ar meirong kan, oh mweidohng re en meirongkihla neirail pwutak mesenih kan. Met pwe I en kaloke irail oh kasalehiong irail me ngehi, KAUN-O.
“Eri met, kowe, nein aramas, ndaiong mehn Israel kan dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanihong irail. Ih ehu ahl met me ar pahpa ko kasohwauwihkiniehla sang ni ar soaloalopwoat.

I ketikiniraildohng nan sahpw me I inoukihda me I pahn ketikihong irail. Ni ar kilangada dohl ile kan oh tuhke losolos kan, re ahpw wiahda ar meirong kan wasa pwuko koaros. Re kahngiangihkiniehda ar meirong isihs kan oh wain me re meirongkihla.
I ahpw keinemwe rehrail: Wasa dah kei me ile me kumwail kohkolahng ie? Eri, re ahpw kahdanekihla wasa pwuko ‘Wasa Ileile ko’
lel rahnwet.
Eri, ndaiong mehn Israel kan dahme I mahmahsanih: Ia kahrepen amwail pahn pil wiahda soangen dihpohte me samamwail ko wiadahr oh idihdawehnte ar dikedik en eni kan?

Pil leledo rahnwet kumwail kin meirongki soangen mehn meirongkohte oh kasaminehkinkumwailla soangen dikedik en enikohte sang ni amwail kin isikala noumwail seri kan wiahki mehn meirong. Oh mwuri, kumwail mehn Israel kan ahpw pil kin kohdo oh rapahki kupwurei! Nin duwen ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, Koht ieias, I sohte pahn mweidohng kumwail en kalelapak rehi mehkot.
Kumwail koasoanedier nan kapehdamwail me kumwail pahn duwehte wehi teikan, duwehte aramas me kin kousoan nan wehi teikan oh pwongih tuhke kan oh takai kan. Ahpw met sohte kak wiawi.
Koht kin ketin Kaloke oh Kupwurmahk
“I kahukihla ni mwarei, ngehi KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht ieias, I kehkehlingkihong kumwail me nan ei engieng I pahn kakaunkin kumwail limei me kehlail kat, iangahki ei manaman unsek.
I pahn kasalehiong kumwail ei manaman oh ei engieng ni ei pahn kapokoneikumwailpene oh kapwureikumwaildohsang nan wehi kan wasa me kumwail kamwarakpesengehr ie.
I pahn ketikinkumwaildohng nan ‘Sapwtehn en Wehi kan,’ oh I ahpw pahn kadeingkumwailda wasao mwohn masamwail kan.
Eri, I pahn kadeingkumwailda met duwehte ei kadeikada samamwail ko ni Sapwtehn Sainai,” KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahsanih met.
“I pahn sapwellimanikihla manaman pohmwail oh kupwurehda pwe kumwail en peikiong ei inowo.

I pahn ketikihsang nanpwungamwail irail ko me kahngohdi oh dipan. I pahn ketikinirailsang nan sahpw akan me re wie koukousoan ie met, ahpw I sohte pahn mweidohng re en pwuralahng nan wehin Israel. Kumwail eri pahn esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O.”

KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahsanih, “Eri met, kumwail mehn Israel kan koaros, kumwail kohwei oh papah noumwail dikedik en eni kan. Ahpw I kehkehlingkihong kumwail me mwurin met kumwail uhdahn pahn peikiong ie oh tokedihsang kasohwauwih mwarei sarawi ni amwail kin wia meirong ong noumwail dikedik en eni kan.
Kumwail mehn Israel koaros pahn kaudokiong ie nan sahpwo, pohn ei nahna sarawio,
oh pohn nahna ileo en Israel. I pahn kupwurperenkin kumwail oh kasik kumwail en wadohng ie amwail meirong kan, amwail meirong keieu kaselel kan, oh amwail meirong sarawi kan.
Mwurin ei pahn kapwureikumwaildo sang nan wehi kan wasa me kumwail kamwaraklahng ie oh kapokoneikumwailpene, I pahn kupwurperenki amwail meirong isihs kan, oh wehi kan pahn kilang me I me sarawi.
Ni ei pahn kapwureikumwaildohng nan Israel, sahpw me I inoukihda me I pahn ketikihong amwail pahpa kahlap ako, eri, kumwail pahn esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O.
Kumwail eri pahn tamanda soahng suwed koaros me kumwail wiadahr oh duwen amwail pein kasamineikumwailla. Kumwail pahn pein suwedkinkumwailla pwehki soahng suwed kan me kumwail wiadahr.

Ni ei pahn mwekid pwehn doarehla wauwi, kumwail mehn Israel kan pahn esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O, pwehki ei sohte kin kalokei kumwail nin duwen me konehng amwail wiewia saut kan.” KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen.
Kisiniei ni Palieir
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, kilenglahng palieir. Lokaiaiong palieir oh wia kokohp me uhwong nanwel en palieir.

Ndaiong nanwel en palieir en rong dahme KAUN-O, ketin mahmahsanih: Kilang! I saundahr kisiniei ehu, oh e pahn kamwasikahla omw tuhke koaros, me meng de mour. Sohte mehkot me pahn kak kakunla. E pahn lulsang ni palieir kolahng paliepeng, oh aramas koaros pahn kehn engin karakar en kisinieio.
Irail koaros ahpw pahn kilang me ngehi, KAUN-O, me isikada oh sohte emen pahn kak kakunla.”
I ahpw soikala, patohwan, “Maing KAUN, Wasa Lapalahpie, komwi dehr mahsanihong ie I en wia met! Aramas koaros kaulimkilahr me ei kokohp kan me apwal en wehwehki.”

footnotes.text: 20.29 WASA ILEILE KO: Wasahn kaudok en me rotorot akan me mehn Ipru kan keinepwihsang re en doadoahngki. Mahsen en Ipru kawehwehdi lepin mahsen wet “Wasa Ile” kereniong duwehte sisen lepin mahsen me wehwehki “me kumwail kohkolahng ie.”
20.40 NAHNA SARAWIO: Nahna Saion, dohl me mi nan Serusalem me wia ekis kisehn wasa me Tehnpas Sarawio oh tehnpesen nanmwarki mi ie.
